verifications.claim: As of March 23, 2026, a recall affects nearly 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's Vegetable Fried Rice, Chicken Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice, and Chicken Shu Mai.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'March 23, 2026... Nearly 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's products... Vegetable Fried Rice... Chicken Fried Rice, Japanese Style Fried Rice and Chicken Shu Mai.'; R2: 'Nearly 10 million pounds of Trader Joe’s Vegetable Fried Rice... Trader Joe’s Chicken Shu Mai... Trader Joe’s Chicken Fried Rice'; R4/R5 similar for ~10M pounds Vegetable Fried Rice and inclusion of others.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state nearly 10M pounds recall as of March 23, 2026, specifying Vegetable Fried Rice at that volume with others included in the Trader Joe's recall.

verifications.claim: The recall is due to potential contamination with glass fragments.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'due to the presence of "foreign objects."... "glass varying in size from 1-3cm long and 2-4mm wide."'; R2: 'slivers of glass'; R3: 'pieces of glass from 1 to 3 centimeters long'; similar in R4/R5.
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly cite glass contamination/fragments/shards as the reason.

verifications.claim: The affected items were sold in 43 states.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'distributed in 43 states: [list]'; R2/R5: 'sold in 43 states'; R3: 'recalled in 43 states'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm distribution/sale in exactly 43 states.

verifications.claim: Affected products have best-buy dates ranging between Feb. 28, 2026, and Aug. 19, 2027.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'best-buy dates ranging from Feb. 28, 2026, to Nov. 19, 2026 [Vegetable Fried Rice]... ranging between Feb. 28, 2026, and Aug. 19, 2027 [Chicken Fried Rice/Shu Mai]'; R1/R5: 'Feb. 28 to Nov. 19'; R4 lists dates spanning Feb-Nov 2026.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm overall range spans Feb. 28, 2026 (earliest) to Aug. 19, 2027 (latest for some products); no contradictions.

verifications.claim: Some reports mention October 2026 for best-buy dates of specific items.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: lists '10/2/2026, 10/6/2026... 10/23/2026'... 'best buy dates between March 5, 2026, and Oct. 23, 2026 [Chicken Fried Rice/Shu Mai]'.
verifications.reasoning: R4 explicitly lists multiple October 2026 best-by dates for recalled items.

verifications.claim: The recall reason is possible presence of foreign objects, specifically hard, clear glass 1–3 cm long from a vegetable ingredient.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '"foreign objects."... "glass varying in size from 1-3cm long and 2-4mm wide."... carrots were "the likely source"'; R2: 'foreign objects... glass... 1 to 3 cm long... "vegetable source ingredient, specifically carrots"'; similar in others.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly match foreign objects/glass 1-3cm long from vegetable (carrots); 'hard, clear' is consistent with glass description though not verbatim.

verifications.claim: Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc. initiated the recall.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc. said in a notice'; R2/R4/R5: 'Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc. recalled/announced'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly attribute initiation of recall to Ajinomoto.

verifications.claim: The recall is an expansion of earlier safety alerts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'initiated on Feb. 19 and expanded on March 3'; R2: 'expansion of a preexisting recall... issued on Feb. 19 and later expanded on March 3'; R5: 'expansion of a recall initially issued last month'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe the recall as an expansion of prior alerts.

verifications.claim: The products were distributed nationwide to 43 states, excluding Hawaii, Maine, New Mexico, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia, and Iowa.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2/R5: '43 states... unaffected... Hawaii, Maine, New Mexico, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia and Iowa'; R1: lists exactly those 43 states (excludes the seven named).
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly match the 43 states and exact exclusions listed.
